Is it really free?
Yes. Playing is free and there is nothing to buy on the site. Short ads inside the games pay the developers and the site.
Do I need to make an account?
No. There is no account, no sign-up and no newsletter. You open a game and play.
Do I have to download or install anything?
No. All the games run in your browser, so there is nothing to download or install.
Can I play on my phone or tablet?

Yes, many games are made for touch and are collected in the Mobile category. Games built for a wide screen will ask you to turn your phone sideways, and a few older games need a keyboard and mouse and say so on their page.
Is it safe for my children?
The site only carries family-friendly games: no adult content, no gambling and no hate. Games for younger players are in the Kids category.
Will my progress and favourites be saved?

Your recently played games, favourites and light or dark choice are kept in your own browser and never leave your device. Most games also save their progress the same way, so clearing your browser data or using private mode will erase them.
A game will not load. What can I do?
I cannot promise a fix for every case, but if it keeps failing, email us at contact@ilovewebgames.com and tell us which game it was. A real person will read it.
Where do the games come from?

There are about 9,209 games. Six were made by Door 404, our own studio, and 20 were sent in directly by independent developers. The rest are licensed from the distribution networks Playgama, GameMonetize and GamePix, and games are never copied from other portals.
How do I submit my own game?

Send it at https://ilovewebgames.com/submit-game/. It is free and non-exclusive, and a real person plays every submission. If it is accepted, your game gets its own page that credits you and links back to you.
Can I have my game removed?
Yes, at any time. Your game stays hosted on your own server, so just email us at contact@ilovewebgames.com and we will take it down.
Can I embed a game on my own website?
Only the games made by Door 404 can be embedded. Each of them has an "Embed this game" box with ready-made code on its page, and games from other developers are not ours to licence.
How do I reach a real person?
Email contact@ilovewebgames.com. The site is run by Door 404, an escape room and game studio from Novi Sad, Serbia.
